summary: Petawawa Heliport (YWA) serves the community of Petawawa in eastern Ontario, Canada, an area closely associated with Canadian Forces Base Petawawa, one of the country's largest and most active military installations. Situated in the scenic Ottawa Valley, the heliport supports regional aviation needs in a predominantly forested region near the Ottawa River. It primarily handles rotary-wing operations serving both military and civilian purposes.

A: Petawawa is located in eastern Ontario, Canada, roughly 160 kilometers northwest of Ottawa, near the Ottawa River.
